{{Top|leg}}
'''Ewok glyphs''' were ancient symbols from the culture of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]],<ref name="EV">{{SW|url=play/online-games/ewok-village|text=Ewok Village|int=Ewok Village}}</ref> a species native to the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> There were at least seven glyphs, some of which held magical properties according to legend within Ewok culture. These properties supposedly gave nearby Ewoks boosted traits.<ref name="EV" />

Glyphs were often carved on trees where Ewoks lived.<ref name="EV" />
